Funny.text:
A madman used to always say: “I will make a slingshot and shoot birds!”

One day he was taken to a mental doctor and treated.

Doctor: What will you do now?
Madman: I will get married, find a job, build a house
Doctor: Very nice! Then?
Madman: I will send my children to good schools, celebrate their birthdays
Doctor: Then?
Madman: I will take out the elastic from their underwear...
then...
“I will make a slingshot and shoot birds!”

A newborn baby asked the nurse: Is there LIGHT?
Nurse: NO
Baby: Oh then I have reached Pakistan 😄

A fly sat on a bald head.
Another fly said: Wow! what a house you got!
First fly said: No, I just bought the land...

In the exam hall, the student was drawing a hand on the paper.
Teacher: There is no question about drawing hands!
Student: I am cursing the person who made this paper 😄

Nature made women beautiful...
Gave beauty...
Eyes like a deer...
Hair like silk...
Lips like rose petals...
Heart full of love...

Then gave them a tongue...
And everything got destroyed 😂

Boy: Uncle, I love a girl
Uncle: Take her father for coffee and talk about marriage
Boy: Uncle, let’s go have coffee 😄

Four things hurt a lot when they end:
1- Love
2- Relationship
3- Trust
4- Sunday 😂

Ant and Elephant got married.
Next day the elephant died.
Ant said: one day of love, whole life digging the grave 😢😂

Beggar: I am hungry, give me some food
Lady: Food is not cooked yet
Beggar: Write your number, give me a missed call when it’s ready 😄

Two things bother me a lot:
(1) Your memories that come often
(2) Electricity that goes often 😂

I was sad throwing stones into water...
Suddenly a frog came out and said: come inside, I will remove your sadness 😄

Girl: I love you 😄
Boy: Propose in a different style
Girl: Will you give my son a chance to carry my funeral? 😂

A dog took his girlfriend on a candle light dinner and said: bow wow 😂
What else was he supposed to say?

A dozen desi eggs 😄
Winter gift
Boil and eat

I lost the game of love...
She was my Paro, I was Devdas
She passed by in a car, I was on a cycle 😂

In life keep moving forward...
keep moving forward...
so much that the person ahead says: please pass 😂

Nowadays there are two types of clerics 😂
A man asks: are you a prayer cleric or an explosion cleric?

Pakistan is the most romantic country 😄
Every night candle light dinner
Thanks to load shedding
